facts.fact: The APD's Conselho de Administração publishes under art. 53(3) of Lei 22/11 a register of entities it has fined for breaching personal data protection rules, showing the authority is constituted and acting; the page is undated, so the capture date 2026-10-11 is used.
The APD's register lists 15 fines under Lei 22/11 for the years 2022 to 2026 (2022: 1, 2023: 1, 2024: 4, 2025: 3, 2026: 6), from US$75,000 to US$525,000 each, with year only and no day given.
facts.system: Lei n.º 22/11 de 17 de Junho - Lei da Protecção de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: The APD fined Crescer Tech US$505,000 in 2026 for failing to notify and obtain authorisation for the international transfer of personal data to a cloud located abroad.
facts.system: Lei n.º 22/11 de 17 de Junho - Lei da Protecção de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: The APD fined Standard Bank de Angola US$150,000 in 2026 for failing to protect the personal data of 51 clients against unauthorised access.
